<h2 style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; ">
  <img src="./icons/user-round.svg" style="height: 1.5em;" alt="Code Icon" />
  About Me
</h2>


**I’m a** recent computer science graduate, and I'm specializing in data analysis and data engineering. I love everything about working with big data, I'm a bit of a geek, especially when it comes to the engineering stories behind data workflows, like the ones [Coding with Lewis](https://www.youtube.com/@CodingWithLewis) and [CodeSource](https://www.youtube.com/@CodeSource) share. 

**I mainly work with** Python, PostgreSQL, Excel or Google Sheets. I’m especially interested in the intersection of software, product and cloud engineering. 

**Currently**, working on my [portfolio](https://pablo-rojas-dev.github.io/) and taking courses on AWS, Java and other tools; I am also practising my containerisation skills using a local server (an old laptop running [Fedora Server](https://fedoraproject.org/en/server/)) to run labs in [Podman](https://podman.io/), [Docker](https://www.docker.com/) and [Floci](https://floci.io/).

My main goal at the moment is to obtain the [AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate certification](https://aws.amazon.com/certification/certified-solutions-architect-associate/).
